2026-08-05.title: Tamil Nadu Budget 2026: TVK sarkar ki pehli budget udyogon ke liye sahi disha mein hai
bullets: Tamil Nadu sarkar ne apni pehli budget mein udyogon ke liye kai naye prastavon ka elan kiya hai, jismein vikas aur audyogik vikas par jor diya gaya hai
Is budget mein kai naye udyogon ki sthapna ke liye 1000 crore rupe ki vittiya sahayata pradan ki jayegi
Is naye budget ke madhyam se Tamil Nadu mein udyogon ka vikas hone ki sambhavana hai

2026-08-05.title: Agni-4 Ballistic Missile ka safal parikshan
bullets: Bharatiya sainya balon ne Agni-4 Ballistic Missile ka safal parikshan kiya hai, jo ki ek bahut bada kadam hai
Is missile ki range 4000 kilometer hai, jo ki isey ek shaktishali missile banata hai
Is parikshan ke madhyam se Bharat apni raksha kshamata ko badhane ki koshish kar raha hai

2026-08-05.title: Karnataka sarkar ne AI-powered digital crop survey ka udghatan kiya
bullets: Karnataka sarkar ne AI-powered digital crop survey ka udghatan kiya hai, jisse kisanon ko fayda hoga
Is yojana ke tahat kisanon ki faslon ki jaankari online ki jayegi, jisse unhein sahi samay par sahi nirdesh milenge
Is yojana se kisanon ki aay mein vriddhi hogi aur ve apne faslon ki dekhbhal behtar tarike se kar payenge

2026-08-05.title: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy ne US Ambassador Sergio Gor se mulakat ki
bullets: Telangana ke mukhyamantri Revanth Reddy ne US Ambassador Sergio Gor se mulakat ki, jismein donon deshon ke beech sambandhon ko majboot banane par charcha hui
Is mulakat mein donon deshon ke beech vyapar aur nivesh ko badhane ke tarike par charcha hui
Is mulakat se Telangana mein naye avsar khulenge aur rajya ka vikas hoga

2026-08-05.title: Tamil Nadu Agriculture Budget: Sarkar ne kisanon ke liye kai naye prastavon ka elan kiya
bullets: Tamil Nadu sarkar ne apne krishi budget mein kisanon ke liye kai naye prastavon ka elan kiya hai, jismein unki aay mein vriddhi hogi
Is budget mein kisanon ko sabse adhik laabh pahunchane ke liye kai yojanaon ka udghatan kiya gaya hai
Is budget se kisanon ki sthiti mein sudhar hoga aur ve apne parivar ke liye behtar jivan jee payenge
